title: StrategySpec
description: USER-DEFINED rule-based trading strategy for the backtest engine (src/backtest/). The user types the strategy out as declarative feature conditions & interactions (e.g. 'vw_vwap_dist < -20 AND of_delta crosses above 0 -> long') OR as a calendar cadence (daily/weekly/monthly entry + settle rules). The referenced Trade Objective still owns labels/KPI/costs defaults so strategies are scored on the SAME frozen evaluation contract as ML model candidates. Conditions are structured data evaluated by src/backtest/rules.py — never free-form code (no eval).

strategy_id.description: Unique strategy id — used for leaderboard rows, trade-ledger and episode filenames.

objective_id.description: Optional cross-check + defaults source. If present it MUST equal the objective the backtest runs against (loader raises otherwise). The objective supplies labels (for signal-quality KPI), session window, and cost defaults.

description.description: Human description of the strategy thesis.

entry.description: Feature-rule entry mode: per-side rule blocks. At least one side required. Mutually exclusive with `schedule`.

schedule.description: Calendar-cadence entry mode (standard daily/weekly/monthly buying + settling rules). Mutually exclusive with `entry`.

entry_time.description: Session-local entry time HH:MM (exchange timezone, e.g. America/Chicago). Default: first bar of the session.

day_of_week.description: Weekly mode: which weekday to enter (skips to the next available trading day if missing).

day_of_month.description: Monthly mode: 'first' / 'last' trading day of the month, or a calendar day 1-28 (rolls forward to the next trading day).

settle.description: How the scheduled position is settled (closed). Default: {mode: eod}.

mode.description: eod = flat at session close same day; hold_bars = exit after N bars; hold_days = exit at session close N trading days later; next_entry = hold until the next scheduled entry (rebalance-style).

bars.description: hold_bars: number of 5s bars to hold.

days.description: hold_days: number of trading days to hold.

predictions.description: Model-prediction entry mode: replay a trained model's OOF/prediction frame as entry signals, gated by confidence. Mutually exclusive with entry|schedule. Exit target/stop/max_holding default to the referenced objective's barriers (move_threshold / mae_tolerance / max_trade_horizon) when omitted. One position at a time is always enforced by the engine — 'max 1 position held' needs no extra knob.

source.description: An oof_*.parquet path, a run directory containing exactly one, or a run id under data/search/<objective>/. Frame columns: ts, direction (up/down/flat), confidence [0,1], optional direction_true.

tau.description: Confidence gate: only bars with confidence >= tau become entry candidates. Ignored when confidence_gate is false.

confidence_gate.description: When false, directional predictions enter regardless of confidence (tau is recorded but not applied). Default true.

sides.description: Which predicted directions to trade. Default: both (up and down).

filters.description: Optional global gate applied to BOTH sides (and to scheduled/prediction entries): entries are only taken on bars where this block is true (e.g. regime / time-of-day filters).

exit.description: Exit rules for rule-mode entries (schedule mode uses `settle`, but target/stop still apply if set here).

target_points.description: Profit target in points from entry.

stop_points.description: Stop loss in points from entry. Same-bar conflicts resolve stop-first (conservative).

max_holding.description: Max holding duration, e.g. '10m', '90s', '2h'. Exit at bar close when reached.

eod_flat.description: Force-close any open position at the last bar of each session (no overnight risk). Default true for rule mode.

rules.description: Optional rule-based exits per side, evaluated bar-by-bar while in a position.

backtest.description: Backtest window + execution knobs — the user's date-range/interface block. CLI --start/--end override start/end.

start.description: Inclusive first trade date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: earliest available parquet.

end.description: Inclusive last trade date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: latest available parquet.

holdout_start.description: Optional in-sample/out-of-sample split: trades entered on/after this date are reported separately (guards against curve-fitting when iterating on rules).

cooldown_bars.description: Bars to wait after a trade closes before a new entry is allowed.

point_value.description: Currency value of one point (e.g. 20 for NQ USD). Default 1.0 = report PnL in points.

max_trades_per_day.description: Cap on entries per session; 0 = unlimited.

max_concurrent_positions.description: Max positions open simultaneously (default 1 = one-at-a-time). A new entry is skipped only when all slots are full at its bar; each position exits independently.

costs.description: Execution frictions. Defaults fall back to the objective's `costs` block when omitted.

slippage_points.description: Slippage applied per side (entry AND exit) in points.

rule_block.description: Boolean combinator over conditions: exactly one of `all` (AND) / `any` (OR). Items may be conditions or nested blocks.

condition.description: One comparison on a feature column. RHS is either a constant `value` or another feature (`feature_rhs`) for feature-interaction rules. `shift` compares against the LHS feature N bars ago is NOT supported — use cross_above/cross_below for prior-bar interactions.

feature.description: Feature column name from the parquet matrix (see docs/reference/FEATURE_CATALOG.md).

op.description: Comparison operator. cross_above/cross_below fire only on the bar where the feature crosses the threshold (feature >= rhs now AND feature < rhs on the prior bar, and vice versa).

feature_rhs.description: Feature-column RHS (feature-vs-feature interaction, e.g. of_volume_ma_60 > rv_realized_vol_60). Mutually exclusive with `value`.
